one_liner: Gumroad has a free, self-serve REST API with OAuth2 and personal access tokens, plus an official hosted MCP server, so a toolkit can ship now.
auth_notes: Register an application under Settings > Advanced to get a client ID and secret for OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Scopes include account, view_sales and edit_products. For your own account you can generate a non-expiring access token from the application page.
access_notes: Any Gumroad account can create an application and token. Gumroad has no subscription plans, and third-party sources report no review queue or billing gate.
blocker_notes: No blocker found. Third-party users must authorize via OAuth.

evidence.quote: you'll need to build a [Redirect URI](https://www.oauth.com/oauth2-servers/redirect-uris/) handler to generate access tokens for each of your users
if you only want to use the API on your own Gumroad account, you can manually generate an access token
no tier gates API access and any account can create an application and issue itself a token
The Gumroad OAuth API is based around REST. We return JSON for every request, including errors.
Listed in Claude’s connector directory. You can also add it as a custom connector.
